description: This file is a Java test class for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino component, testing various mapping scenarios such as incoming and outgoing message transformations, including handling of different content types, statuses, and payload formats.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino component, containing setup and multiple test cases to verify mapping behavior.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes static mapper instances with different configurations before all tests.

methods.name: testNoopJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Tests incoming message mapping where the script is a no-operation, verifying message remains unchanged.

methods.name: testNoopJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Tests outgoing message mapping where the script is a no-operation, verifying message transformation correctness.

methods.name: testDefaultJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Verifies the default outgoing message mapping produces a JSON structure matching the input.

methods.name: testDefaultJavascriptOutgoingMappingWithStatus
methods.description: Checks that outgoing messages include a status code when configured to do so.

methods.name: testDefaultJavascriptOutgoingMappingWithStatusAndExtra
methods.description: Verifies outgoing message mapping includes extra metadata fields when configured.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Tests incoming mapping with a plain text payload, asserting correct parsing into an adaptable object.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptIncomingMappingWithStatus
methods.description: Tests incoming mapping with status code from a modification response, verifying correct mapping.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptIncomingMappingWithStatusAndExtra
methods.description: Verifies that incoming message with extra fields gains correct payload and topic path attributes.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Verifies outgoing mapping for a creation command, ensuring correct payload transformation.

methods.name: testEmptyJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Ensures that empty incoming messages yield an empty list of adaptables.

methods.name: testEmptyJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Checks that mappings for empty adaptables produce no external message.

methods.name: testBinaryJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Verifies binary incoming message mapping, decoding byte payload to string and parsing.

methods.name: testBinaryJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Tests binary outgoing message construction with ByteBuffer payload containing the thing ID.

methods.name: byteBuffer2String
methods.description: Utility method to convert ByteBuffer to String for assertions.
